This project is a Django web app with a study help focus. It includes user authentication, an admin panel, a homepage with app cards, help videos per app, a sidebar with 'Help Videos' and 'YourGuide' modules, and CSV-based expert lookup. Use best practices for Django apps, Bootstrap for UI, and pandas for CSV handling.
